verdict.rationale: Granola's own iOS and Android apps support AI-enhanced notes for in-person meetings, with transcription in 17 mobile languages, and a beta tester's Apple Watch report corroborates mobile capture. Chat can then query across all meetings. However, no evidence explicitly says mobile-captured notes sync into the same workspace as desktop notes or are searchable there; that is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that mobile notes land in the shared/desktop workspace, explicit in-workspace search of mobile notes, and independent hands-on corroboration of mobile in-person transcription.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace

citations.quote: Granola for mobile lets you take AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings (and, on iOS, phone calls).
Granola supports 31 languages on desktop (macOS and Windows) and 17 languages on mobile (iOS and Android).
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
